status: unexecuted AI engineering development proposal; not an execution registration or student final design
hypothesis: A fixed truth-blind fractional-velocity-update penalty permits meaningful returned velocity recovery beyond the supplied initialization and unregularized exact inversion at the same complete time allowance, rather than merely suppressing damaging drift.

production_source_contract_to_preserve.note: This staging component does not mutate production source. A future driver requires independent review and an explicit execution freeze.

proposed_development_scope.case_identity_status: Proposed same inspected development slices; a future registration must bind input hashes and confirm the exact existing order.
proposed_development_scope.order: Shuffle two arms inside every case/repetition; exact seed and full 48-slot order must be saved in a later reviewed execution registration before project array decode.
proposed_development_scope.initialization: Identical native-m bytes in both arms; no velocity roundtrip. Existing truth-derived synthetic smoothing initializer must be disclosed as a supplied-prior assumption.

objective.normalization: Phi(m0) must be positive finite and evaluated under the run clock. Both arms use identical normalization; no floor and no reuse of historical unnormalized baseline outcomes.
objective.edge_rule: Each nearest-neighbour edge once; no periodic edges, ghosts, or edge-count normalization.
objective.weight_interpretation: A spatially constant 10% fractional velocity update has R=0.005 and lambda*R=0.5 at lambda=100.
objective.prior_scale_status: Fixed engineering values, not noise-estimated, physically calibrated, truth-tuned, or guaranteed optimal. Noiseless observations do not support a discrepancy-principle claim.
objective.lambda_zero_behavior: Return Phi/Phi0 and g/Phi0 without evaluating R; all actually incurred constructor and validation costs remain paid.
objective.initial_gradient_limitation: R and its gradient equal zero at m0; this prior does not change the already inspected initial data-gradient direction.

proposed_matched_allowance_contract.solver: Exact native-m L-BFGS-B for both arms; maxcor10, maxls12, ftol1e-12, gtol1e-10. Later implementation must retain complete library-default and query accounting.
proposed_matched_allowance_contract.work_reuse: No cross-arm/cross-run factor, field, normalization, receipt or optimizer-history sharing.
proposed_matched_allowance_contract.quality_selection: Only the last chronologically eligible model, with no truth-based checkpoint choice. Late/failed returns retain outcomes and receive no success credit.
proposed_matched_allowance_contract.cost_claim_limit: Shared allowance is not exact equality of actual consumed time. Record actual times and work; report shared bootstrap and all development cost separately, with no free tuning or training claim.

successful_case_requires_all: regularized case-median velocity error <=0.90*initial velocity error
regularized case-median velocity error <=0.90*paired normalized exact data-only case median
fixed_proposed_development_continuation_.failures: Any incomplete eligibility group fails the continuation gate; preserve every planned slot without replacing, omitting, selecting repetitions or imputing a successful deadline.
fixed_proposed_development_continuation_.interpretation: Heuristic preregisterable development gates, not IID inference, geological confirmation, method novelty, competition readiness, or a final student design.

future_controls_required: prove regularizer construction is unchanged when an unavailable truth label changes while supplied initializer stays fixed
keep truth metric computation strictly after return without feedback
bind exact observed-data and initializer source hashes
independently review source/dataflow before project execution

stop_go.if_failed: Preserve the negative result. Do not promote best-looking cases or retrospectively select a different lambda as confirmation.
stop_go.if_passed: Freeze this candidate before independent-ancestry, physically accepted confirmation. Only then assess certificate acceleration against the useful exact baseline at fully paid total cost.
stop_go.novelty: Classical Tikhonov-style update regularization. Positive recovery would strengthen the baseline/task, not establish a distinct certification contribution.
